title: Paintings Expanded
description: Enhance your world with Paintings Exapanded, a vanilla-style datapack that adds 15+ unique, high-quality pixel art paintings to decorate your builds, ranging from cozy landscapes to mysterious artifacts.
body:
Tired of the same old vanilla artwork? Paintings Expanded expands your interior design options with six brand-new, hand-crafted pixel art pieces. Whether you are building a modern garage, a dark dungeon, or a coastal retreat, these paintings fit perfectly into the Minecraft aesthetic while adding much-needed variety to your walls.

⚠️ **REQUIRED RESOURCE PACK**
For this datapack to work correctly, you MUST install the accompanying Resource Pack. Without it, the paintings will not display properly.

Download Paintings Expanded RP:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/paintings-expanded-resource-pack
